w: In the evening assembly Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees of Augusta.

Mr. Mark Gibbons presented Swamishri, on behalf of the Mayor of Augusta, the Honorary Citizenship of the city of Augusta. Senator Mr. Charles Walker and Congressman Mr. Ben Harbin welcomed Swamishri with a bouquet of flowers.

No Spiritual Difference in Shriji Maharaj's Murtis A young boy, called Kirtan, who studies at the BAPS hostel in Abu, India, asked Swamishri, "Bapa, what is the difference between the murti of Ghanshyam Maharaj in Abu and the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj with you?" Swamishri replied, "There is no difference at all. They are one." Kirtan had observed that Swamishri's Thakorji - Lord Harikrishna Maharaj - is offered profuse devotion and receives maximum attention and respect from all. To satisfy a child's curiosity regarding the difference in his mind, Swamishri conveyed that though the murtis of Lord Swaminarayan may be different in name and form yet it is the same Shriji Maharaj who accepts the devotion and prayers of devotees in all of them.

w: Bal - Balika Din On Bal-Balika Din the evening cultural programme began with a kirtan aradhana by the balaks. After Swamishri's arrival, they acted out various incidents from Swamishri's life that serve as examples for them to follow.

They also presented a drama about a poor shopkeeper who was unable to reap the benefits of a parasmani that had the capability to change metal to gold, simply because he failed to recognise its importance. The balaks then described how they have recognised the parasmani in the form of Swamishri, who transforms their lives into gold by inspiring them to lead moral lives. In his blessings to the assembly, Swamishri praised the efforts of the children. He also explained to all parents, "Everyone in the world puts great emphasis on educating their children, but in addition to this, if values are instilled in them then they will do great things, and will be able to serve society."
